This indicates that staurosporine may exert its effects through a series of molecular pathways that ultimately influence the function of this transporter. The presence of a consistent target relationship across different biological contexts suggests a plausible mechanism, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports the idea that staurosporine could modulate the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2A1, potentially through the inhibition of downstream signaling pathways or by affecting the expression or function of its targets. The integration of these findings highlights the importance of further experimental validation to confirm the direct relationship between staurosporine and the transporter.
